2608.25258.title: Neural-Bayesian Structure Learning for Discrete Choice Modeling
2608.25258.paper_summary: Conventional discrete choice and machine learning models are estimated primarily from observational data and typically treat explanatory covariates as parallel inputs, providing no internal mechanism for determining how related attributes should adjust when one is deliberately changed. This paper proposes Neural-Bayesian Structure Learning (Neural-BSL), a framework coupling differentiable structure learning with random-utility-based discrete choice estimation in a single differentiable procedure. To prevent mutually exclusive choice outcome from distorting the recovered attribute structure, the observed choice is maintained outside the graph as an alternative-specific utility comparison, while the attribute structure and random-utility parameters are learned jointly. The learned structure enters the choice model through structure-weighted attribute interactions and provides the structural basis for propagating interventions through downstream attributes. An intervention is evaluated by updating the intervened attribute, propagating its model-implied downstream changes in topological order, and then recomputing utilities and choice probabilities. This yields both predicted mode-share responses and the associated changes in downstream traveler or trip attributes. We evaluate Neural-BSL using stated-preference data from Seoul and the revealed-preference data from London. Neural-BSL achieves predictive performance comparable to conventional benchmarks while recovering behaviorally coherent dependency structures. Across policy scenarios, propagating interventions through the learned structure changes the predicted redistribution across modes while exposing the downstream traveler and trip adjustments underlying those responses.
2608.25258.paper_summary_zh: 傳統的離散選擇和機器學習模型主要是從觀察數據中估計的，通常將解釋性協變量視為平行輸入，並未提供內部機制來確定當一個屬性被故意改變時，相關屬性應如何調整。本文提出了神經貝葉斯結構學習（Neural-BSL），這是一個將可微結構學習與基於隨機效用的離散選擇估計結合在單一可微過程中的框架。為了防止互斥的選擇結果扭曲恢復的屬性結構，觀察到的選擇被保持在圖外，作為一種替代特定的效用比較，而屬性結構和隨機效用參數則是共同學習的。學習到的結構通過結構加權的屬性交互進入選擇模型，並為通過下游屬性傳播干預提供結構基礎。通過更新被干預的屬性，按照拓撲順序傳播其模型暗示的下游變化，然後重新計算效用和選擇概率來評估干預。這產生了預測的模式分享反應以及與之相關的下游旅行者或行程屬性的變化。我們使用來自首爾的陳述偏好數據和來自倫敦的揭示偏好數據來評估Neural-BSL。Neural-BSL實現了與傳統基準相當的預測性能，同時恢復行為上連貫的依賴結構。在政策情境中，通過學習到的結構傳播干預改變了預測的模式再分配，同時暴露了那些反應背後的下游旅行者和行程調整。
